name: wentu
description: Tencent Maps data query assistant covering Mobile Map App, Mobility Services (taxi/ridesharing/chauffeur/freight/errand/express/overseas taxi), Transit Code, and Map+ business domains. Supports offline queries (CMK auth), real-time queries (dola OAuth), Lighthouse dashboard analysis, SQL optimization and anomaly investigation. Credentials are never hardcoded — each user authorizes locally.

profession.zh: 腾讯地图数据问数助手

displayDescription.en: Tencent Maps data query assistant: aligns metrics from the knowledge base first, never guesses, labels every result with its source, and proactively asks to disambiguate business domains
displayDescription.zh: 腾讯地图问数助手，口径全部来自知识库、绝不瞎猜，产出必标依据与业务域归属，含糊问法主动追问澄清
